items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: Harrison's. Tommy Harrison and her name was Marie Harrison.

ctx.x: Yeah, I remember. What was their name again?

Harrison's. Tommy Harrison and her name was Marie Harrison. But at that time, Paul had an awful good band and they sort of brought back jazz in that 34 because at that time they were the only band playing what they felt like playing. They weren't told to play this, tell them to play that, just Paul kicked the tunes off and they played what they wanted. And I spoke to a lot of musicians at that time and they all said that this band was probably swinging a jazz band, Dixieland band in the nation at that time…

Yes, there's other things you can tell. As I say, 50 years when we're all gone, people are going to have all sorts of rumors about these records and the studio and everything else here. We might mention a little bit more about the studio. It's in a back room here. Did you build this especially? It's back away from the street where it's entirely soundproof.
